question: Should the canonical Carapace guidance preserve v0.1.x compatibility by using only released tokens, or should the matching CSS token contract be released before this generated update lands?
rationale: The branch is generated correctly from its upstream source, but choosing between compatibility-preserving documentation and a package-release change defines the supported public contract.

options.title: Version-gate guidance to released tokens
options.body: Update the canonical guidance so legacy v0.1.x consumers receive only tokens defined by that release, then regenerate this PR.

options.title: Release the matching CSS contract
options.body: Publish the CSS token set that includes the documented variables, update the supported consumer version, and regenerate the skill output.

recommendation.title: Version-gate guidance to released tokens
recommendation.body: Update the canonical guidance so legacy v0.1.x consumers receive only tokens defined by that release, then regenerate this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They documented the incompatibility and the two contract-level resolution paths in the PR discussion.
